title: Utilization Management Program Quantity Limits and Maximum Exception Multiples
content:
Quantity limits under the Utilization Management Program are the maximum covered quantity of a drug, in units, per rolling 30 days without a quantity limit exception. Quantity is counted over a rolling 30-day period on every package.

## Limits per rolling 30 days (units)

| Review package | sumatriptan | Nurtec ODT | Ubrelvy | oxycodone-acetaminophen |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | no limit listed | no limit listed | no limit listed | 180 |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 9 | 8 | 16 | 180 |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 9 | 8 | 16 | 180 |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 9 | 8 | 16 | 120 |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 9 | 8 | 16 | 120 |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 9 | 8 | 16 | 120 |

## Exception terms

| Review package | Maximum exception multiple (highest approvable quantity as a multiple of the drug's limit) | Period basis | Opioid claims above the network's daily MME limit can be approved by a quantity limit exception |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 2.0 | rolling 30 days | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 2.0 | rolling 30 days | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 2.0 | rolling 30 days | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 1.5 | rolling 30 days | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 1.5 | rolling 30 days | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 1.5 | rolling 30 days | Yes |

### Worked figures from the schedule

The maximum exception multiple times a drug's limit gives the highest approvable quantity the schedule allows:

- sumatriptan on Northbridge Clinical Standard: 9 multiplied by 2.0 is 18 units per rolling 30 days.
- Ubrelvy on Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive: 16 multiplied by 1.5 is 24 units per rolling 30 days.
- oxycodone-acetaminophen on Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus: 120 multiplied by 1.5 is 180 units per rolling 30 days.
